five-faced Father, splendor hidden — may the Heart flash forth, deathless kin beyond all, for me.

lines: Knowledge frees — opposing bondage-cause ignorance, twofold:
intellect-seated doubt and wrong-conviction, person-seated churning thought —
that last, saṃsāra's root. Initiation may wash the personal —
but needs decided shun-and-take; so deciding knowledge leads,
and practiced, kills the personal too — practice ends thought-free.
Pure knowing only — Lord-spoken scripture frees altogether.

lines: Own-nature alone most adoptable — light-nature of all, since non-light cannot be nature;
one, autonomous, everywhere. Its freedom bliss, its wonder will,
its light awareness, its grasp knowing, all-form-fitness action —
resting in own bliss, Śiva — contracting, called atom; showing again, with means or without, threefold, fourfold, to spread it full.
